comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
*Message for the developers of ivyro*

I am not sure if this is allowed or not, but I want to ask something regarding the current state of ivyro.

I am lately noticing that the quests after the Gran Atlas aren't added still. This one for example has been named, but there is no source from which quest it is (which is culmination of bow study (G.T.)). It's been almost a year that this update applied to GAMA server and yet not everything from Chapter 1 is updated?

Of course most of us are adding the quest names plus the requirements through comment that helps all of us despite not being added on ivyro yet, however how long does it have to go like that? It would be easier to add those quests that are released from the latest update and I can understand it can take a while, but NOT a year.

For me is this database always useful no matter what, I am also using JP and Taiwan wiki source to compare the information of it. However I am writing this for the sake of this Database too and want to state clear that certain aspects needs to be updated, because some are outdated too.

I hope my explanation about this is clear and that you people realise that this can help the most players greatly. ^^

Kind Regards,

Huseyin-Gazi

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Very good point. I suggest that developers of ivyro could give the rights for ivyro community to update the database. There are some really trusty contributors to this site. I think they will gladly do this :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Some good suggestions/observations, and ones I hope can be heeded. We used to have comments be possible without accounts, and no moderators available to delete offensive/spam based comments, but that changed in time, after all.

And a lot of information is already present in the database, just not 'linked' together, or translated into English. With the fourth and final chapter of Gran Atlas approaching (I'm guessing next month will be the release date, but it could be sooner or later than that), the next big update, Atlantis, won't be far off. There'll be a lot more information to keep track of and enter in when that happens, especially in terms of recipes (hello improved Alchemy) and Memorial Albums... heh, and dungeons, too.

We all love this database dearly. It's seen us through our voyages many times, and so it's natural that we want to see it continue to grow, and be able to help not only us, but future players of UWO still to come. Thank you for your consideration, site maintainer(s), and thank you for everything you've done on behalf of UWO fans the world over. Cheers.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
Heya Guilder,

No problem ^^ I am still willing to contribute this for players and to improve some sections. My point is to awake the database more so that we can keep up with the latest updates.

But I will see how it turns out. Again thank you also for contributing the database greatly as well. :-)

Kind Regards,

Huseyin-Gazi
